decision_rule_original: Enters Stage4 as a declared secondary condition only if mean RET-GS declines by no more than .02, unseen false fires do not increase, and at least one preregistered tail statistic changes by more than its seed spread; otherwise report a null result.

decision_rule_proposal_requiring_owner_a.interpretation: a changed tail is not necessarily an improvement; multiple diagnostics are descriptive and do not establish confirmatory significance
decision_rule_proposal_requiring_owner_a.missing: any missing, failed or nonfinite assay makes the decision unavailable; do not silently exclude seeds
decision_rule_proposal_requiring_owner_a.ret_gs: equal-weight mean across 3 datasets and 3 seeds >= kappa0 mean - .02
decision_rule_proposal_requiring_owner_a.seed_spread: for each statistic, use max(range across kappa seeds, range across kappa0 seeds) on equal-weight per-dataset means; absolute difference of means must exceed it; print direction and all tested statistics
decision_rule_proposal_requiring_owner_a.unseen: per dataset, mean across 3 seeds at 100 records <= same-dataset kappa0; report counts and denominators

definition.clip: min(-ln p_target,c), answer only; preserve ordinary KL
definition.numerical_requirement: explicit kappa=0 branch; -expm1(-kappa*surprisal)/kappa for positive kappa; finite nonnegative configuration; current code does not meet all these gates
definition.retrieval: ordinary categorical CE unchanged in form; shared reader weights can still change boundary behavior

design.clipping_match: c=2 matches kappa=.5 ceiling; kappa=.2 has ceiling5 and is NOT ceiling-matched by this control. A second c=5 control would change the 12-training design and budget; owner must resolve before execution.

reference_version.ambiguous_reference: Abstract reference Nelson (2023/2024), Coupled entropy for complex systems is not an unambiguous version; owner/author clarification still needed.
reference_version.mapping: The paper defines log_Q(x)=(x^Q-1)/Q, but its Eq.(3) surprisal is log_Q(1/p)=-log_-Q(p). Our bounded -log_kappa(p) corresponds to Q=-kappa for that surprisal, not identical positive-Q convention. Ordinary expectation here is not the complete coupled-entropy construction.
reference_version.title: Nonlinear statistical coupling
